sources.snippet: Zora v1.13: An Honest LLM for Southeast Europe Zora v1.13, developed by Sovasoft, is an 8 billion parameter language model based on Qwen3-8B, specifically engineered for 12 languages of the Balkans and Southeast Europe. Unlike models that hallucinate, Zora is designed to be honest, providing multi-perspective views on contested topics and explicitly stating when it doesn't know an answer.
